rates.label: Minimum to start a Flexi Pension
rates.quote: You need a minimum of $25,000 to start a Flexi Pension.

rates.label: Must stay in accumulation when starting a pension from part of a balance
rates.quote: you must leave at least $6,000 in your UniSuper accumulation account

rates.label: Balance at which a Flexi Pension is paid out
rates.quote: Your Flexi Pension will continue until the balance reduces to $10,000

rates.label: Minimum Flexi Pension lump sum withdrawal
rates.quote: You can make lump sum withdrawals of at least $2,000

rates.label: TTR maximum annual payment
rates.quote: You can take up to a maximum of 10% of your account balance at the start of each financial year (or your initial account balance for the first year)

rates.label: TTR maximum is not pro-rated
rates.quote: The maximum amount for TTR Flexi Pension isn't subject to the pro-rata rules.

rates.label: Minimum payment rounding
rates.quote: ($18,698.63 rounded to the nearest $10)

rates.label: Pension started 1 to 30 June may skip that year's payment
rates.quote: If you start your Flexi Pension between 1 June and 30 June, you can choose not to receive an income payment until the next financial year.

rates.label: Payment frequency if none chosen
rates.quote: If you don't nominate a frequency, you'll receive your payments monthly.

rates.label: Flexi Pension withdrawal paid
rates.quote: usually within five business days of receiving your request

rates.label: General transfer balance cap, first pension on or after 1 July 2026
rates.quote: on or after 1 July 2026 will have a transfer balance cap of $2.1 million

rates.label: Personal transfer balance cap range
rates.quote: between $1.6 million and $2.1 million, depending on their circumstances

rates.label: Temporary Accumulation 1 account closes at the latest
rates.quote: or 90 days after we receive the first transfer or contribution, whichever happens first

rates.label: Cooling-off period
rates.quote: You have 14 days from when your Flexi Pension is opened to decide if it's right for you.

rates.label: Retirement Bonus: continuous membership needed before transfer
rates.quote: have held a UniSuper super and/or TTR Flexi Pension account for a continuous 12-month period immediately before the transfer

rates.label: Retirement Bonus clawback trigger
rates.quote: If you withdraw 50% or more of your opening balance within 12 months of starting your Retirement Phase Flexi Pension, the Trustee may claw back the Retirement Bonus.

rates.label: Superannuation guarantee rate
rates.quote: The minimum SG percentage rate is 12%.

rates.label: Concessional contributions cap, 2026-27
rates.quote: A cap of $32,500 applies to concessional contributions during the 2026-27 financial year.

rates.label: Non-concessional contributions cap
rates.quote: you can generally contribute up to the annual non-concessional contributions cap of $130,000

rates.label: Carry-forward: total super balance must be under
rates.quote: you must have a total super balance of less than $500,000 as at 30 June of the financial year immediately preceding

rates.label: Unused concessional cap can be carried forward for
rates.quote: Unused concessional contributions can be carried forward for up to five years

rates.label: Bring-forward available if under this age during the year
rates.quote: If you're under 75 years of age at any time during a financial year, you may be able to 'bring forward' up to three years of non-concessional contributions

rates.label: Tax on excess non-concessional contributions left in super
rates.quote: the excess will be taxed at 47%

rates.label: Excess concessional contributions that can be released
rates.quote: You can release up to 85% of your excess concessional contributions from your accumulation super account.

rates.label: Division 293 threshold
rates.quote: Division 293 super contributions of more than $250,000 within a financial year, an additional tax of 15%

rates.label: Division 296: total super balance above
rates.quote: If your TSB exceeds $3 million, you will be subject to Division 296 tax of 15%

rates.label: Division 296: additional 10% above
rates.quote: if your TSB exceeds $10 million, you will be subject to additional Division 296 tax of 10%

rates.label: Co-contribution: full amount if total income at or below
rates.quote: If your total income is $49,293 per annum or less for 2026-27

rates.label: Co-contribution: phases out completely at
rates.quote: before phasing out completely if you earn $64,293 per annum or more

rates.label: Co-contribution maximum
rates.quote: up to a maximum of $500 in government co-contributions

rates.label: Co-contribution per $1 of non-concessional contributions
rates.quote: the government may contribute $0.50 to your account for every dollar of non-concessional contributions

rates.label: LISTO: adjusted taxable income up to
rates.quote: for individuals with an adjusted taxable income up to $37,000

rates.label: LISTO maximum
rates.quote: provides a tax offset of up to $500 per annum

rates.label: Spouse contribution tax offset maximum
rates.quote: The maximum spouse contribution tax offset of $540 is available if you make contributions of up to $3,000

rates.label: Spouse offset: spouse income for full offset
rates.quote: if your spouse's income threshold doesn't exceed $37,000

rates.label: Spouse offset: phases out at spouse income of
rates.quote: will completely phase out once your spouse's income reaches $40,000

rates.label: Contribution split maximum
rates.value: Lesser of 85% of concessional contributions and the concessional cap
rates.quote: The maximum amount of contributions that can be split each financial year is the lesser of: 85% of your concessional contributions, and the concessional contributions cap applicable to you.

rates.label: Contribution split deadline
rates.value: 30 June of the following financial year
rates.quote: To split contributions made for the previous financial year, you must lodge

rates.label: Downsizer contribution limit
rates.quote: you may be able to contribute up to $300,000 ($600,000 per couple) into super from the proceeds of selling your home

rates.label: Downsizer contribution timing
rates.quote: generally within 90 days of settlement

rates.label: First home super saver: per financial year
rates.quote: You can make up to $15,000 of voluntary (concessional or non-concessional) contributions to your accumulation super per financial year and up to $50,000 in total under the scheme.

rates.label: Work test for deductions, ages 67 to 74
rates.quote: you must have worked for at least 40 hours in a period of not more than 30 consecutive days in the financial year the contribution is made

rates.label: Contributions accepted after turning 75
rates.value: Up to 28 days after the end of the birthday month
rates.quote: We can accept contributions up to 28 days after the end of the month in which you turn 75.

rates.label: Extra tax on contributions with no TFN
rates.quote: If you haven't provided your TFN, an additional tax of 32% may be deducted (totalling 47%) from assessable contributions

rates.label: Provide TFN within this period to recover no-TFN tax
rates.quote: If you provide your TFN within the three financial years following the contribution, we may be able to claim the additional 'No TFN' tax back from the ATO.

rates.label: Withholding on a benefit under 60 with no TFN
rates.quote: If you're under 60 and haven't provided your TFN, we're required to withhold 47% tax of the taxable component of benefits paid to you.

rates.label: Lump sum tax below preservation age
rates.value: 22% or marginal rate, whichever is lower
rates.quote: tax will be withheld from the entire taxable component at a rate of 22% or your marginal tax rate, whichever is lower

rates.label: Death benefit to a non-dependant: taxed element
rates.quote: up to 17% tax is withheld on any taxed element, and 32% on any untaxed element

rates.label: Terminal medical condition certification
rates.value: Less than 24 months to live, two practitioners
rates.quote: if you get certification that you have less than 24 months to live from two registered medical practitioners

rates.label: Release when leaving an employer with a tiny balance
rates.quote: having an account balance of less than $200 when you terminate employment with an employer who contributed to UniSuper

rates.label: Departing Australia withholding tax
rates.quote: is generally subject to withholding tax of 35% (or 65% for working holiday makers)

rates.label: Unclaimed temporary resident super sent to the ATO after
rates.quote: If temporary residents don't claim their super within six months of departing Australia, we'll transfer it to the ATO

rates.label: Transfers out allowed
rates.value: Up to eight in any 12 months
rates.quote: You may request a transfer up to eight times in each 12-month period.

rates.label: Partial transfer out must leave
rates.quote: If you're not transferring the entire amount out of your UniSuper account then you must leave at least $6,000 in your account.

rates.label: Inactive low-balance account sent to the ATO
rates.quote: If your account has been identified as inactive for a period of 16 months and has a balance of less than $6,000, we're required to send it to the ATO

rates.label: Lapsing binding nomination lasts
rates.quote: A valid binding death benefit nomination (lapsing) remains in effect for three years from the date it was first signed, last amended or confirmed.

rates.label: Accumulation administration fee
rates.value: Lesser of $96 or 2% of balance a year
rates.quote: The lesser of $96 or 2% of

rates.label: Accumulation fee when month-end balance is under $4,800
rates.value: One month's worth of the 2% annual fee
rates.quote: If at the end of the month your account balance is less than $4,800 (including investment returns, where applied) you'll be charged one month's worth of the 2% annual fee.

rates.label: Retirement Phase and BIS administration fee
rates.value: $96 a year ($8 a month) plus 0.08% capped at $1,250
rates.quote: 0.08% of your account balance per year, capped at $1,250 per account per financial year.

rates.label: TTR administration fee
rates.value: Nil while paid under TTR rules
rates.quote: Nil while paid under TTR rules

rates.label: Fee cap for balances under $6,000 at year end
rates.quote: If your account balance is less than $6,000 at the end of UniSuper's income year, certain fees and costs charged to you in relation to administration and investment are capped at 3% of the account balance.

rates.label: Notice before a new or increased fee
rates.quote: We'll give you 30 days' written notice before a new or increased fee that we charge directly takes effect.

rates.label: Balanced investment fee, accumulation and TTR
rates.quote: 0.39%1 per year.

rates.label: Balanced investment fee, Retirement Phase
rates.quote: Balanced investment option 0.32%1 per year.

rates.label: Balanced transaction costs
rates.quote: 0.06% per year.

rates.label: Default Death and TPD cover
rates.value: 10 units from age 25 with a $6,000 balance
rates.quote: you'll automatically receive 10 units of default Death and/or TPD cover after you're aged 25 and have an account balance of at least $6,000

rates.label: Top-up cover without health evidence
rates.value: Up to 10 units within 180 days of default cover starting
rates.quote: You can also apply for up to 10 units of top-up Death and/or TPD cover within 180 days of your default cover automatically starting

rates.label: Apply for cover without health evidence after starting with an eligible employer
rates.quote: You have 180 days from the date you first start employment with an eligible employer to apply for insurance cover without having to provide health evidence to the Insurer.

rates.label: Cover starts only if an employer contribution arrives within
rates.quote: Your cover will only start if an employer contribution is received within 180 days.

rates.label: Income Protection without health evidence
rates.value: Up to 23 units, maximum 85% of income
rates.quote: you can apply for up to 23 units of Income Protection cover (equivalent to a maximum pre-tax benefit of $9,967 per month), subject to a maximum of 85% of your pre-disability income

rates.label: One Income Protection unit
rates.quote: Income Protection cover is available in units of cover where each unit is valued at $100 per week.

rates.label: Default Income Protection terms
rates.quote: The benefit period is two years with a waiting period of 90 days.

rates.label: Death cover ceases at
rates.quote: Death cover ceases at age 75.

rates.label: TPD cover ceases at
rates.quote: TPD cover ceases at age 70.

rates.label: Income Protection ceases at
rates.quote: Income Protection cover ceases at age 67.

rates.label: Cover stops with no contribution or rollover for
rates.quote: Your account hasn't received a contribution or rollover for 16 consecutive months, and prior to that you didn't elect to keep cover

rates.label: Apply to restart stopped cover within
rates.quote: apply within 90 days of your cover being stopped

rates.label: Insurance administration fee
rates.quote: an administration fee of 4% of the insurance premium charged

rates.label: Tax adjustment credited on premiums
rates.quote: effectively reducing the amount you pay by 15%

rates.label: Professional occupation classification income test
rates.quote: you earn at least $130,000 per annum excluding superannuation contributions

rates.label: Professional classification rating factor (from 28 November 2026)
rates.quote: The Professional occupation classification rating factor that applies to her cover is 0.88 for Death cover and 0.88 for TPD cover.

rates.label: Life Events cover available if under
rates.quote: If you are under age 55, you may be eligible to apply to increase your existing Death, TPD or Income Protection cover when your life changes

rates.label: Transfer cover from another fund if under
rates.quote: If you are less than age 65 and have Death, TPD, or Income Protection cover with another super fund or other provider, you may be eligible to transfer this cover to UniSuper.

rates.label: Investment switch timing
rates.value: Before 2pm on a Melbourne business day, processed two Melbourne business days later
rates.quote: Requests received before 2pm on a Melbourne business day are processed two Melbourne business days later.

rates.label: Investment switches take up to
rates.quote: Investment switches take up to three Melbourne business days to be processed and become effective

rates.label: Complaint outcome: super
rates.quote: 45 days for super complaints

rates.label: Complaint outcome: financial advice
rates.quote: 30 days for financial advice complaints

rates.label: Complaint outcome: death benefit objection
rates.quote: 90 days for objections to death benefit distributions (starting after the 28-day deadline to submit your objection)

rates.label: Fund reduces an excess transfer balance within
rates.quote: require that reduction be made within 60 days

rates.label: Tax on notional earnings of an excess transfer balance
rates.quote: The tax rate is 15% for the first breach and increases to 30% for any further breaches.

rates.label: Error compensation materiality threshold
rates.quote: UniSuper will generally use a materiality threshold of 0.30% of the account
